jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Baytown, TX is seeking a Security Officer Access Compliance to safeguard clients at a retail distribution location. You will verify credentials, monitor entry points, manage visitor access, and document security activity to keep the site secure and welcoming.

The role emphasizes visible presence, professional communication, and adherence to access-control procedures across shifts, with a focus on preventing incidents and ensuring safe operations.

jobs.title: Retail Security & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Retail Security Officer to safeguard clients across Commercial Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, Government, and more. You will provide customer service while following site-specific policies and emergency procedures.

This role involves responding to incidents with calm, performing regular patrols, and adapting to different client environments. A background check and drug screen are required, with state licensing considerations as applicable.
